```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# annotated CNR files
cnr_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/CNVKit/Annotated_cnr_file"

# List all annotated cnr files
files <- list.files(
  path = cnr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.annotated\\.cnr$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

# Check total number of sample files
num_samples <- length(files)
cat("Total number of samples:", num_samples, "\n\n")

# Extract sample names without extension
sample_names <- sub("\\.annotated\\.cnr$", "", files)

# case defined by first 4 letters
case_ids <- substr(sample_names, 1, 4)

# case defined by part before "-"
# case_ids <- sub("-.*", "", sample_names)

# Count unique cases
unique_cases <- unique(case_ids)
num_cases <- length(unique_cases)

cat("Total number of cases:", num_cases, "\n\n")

# Show case IDs
cat("Unique case IDs:\n")
print(unique_cases)

# Count how many samples per case
case_table <- table(case_ids)

cat("\nNumber of samples per case:\n")
print(case_table)

```
```{r}
# ===============================
# Function to extract event columns
# ===============================
read_event_info <- function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f)

  sample_name <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$")

  corrected_call_col <- grep("\\.Corrected_Call$", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  event_col          <- grep("\\.event$", names(dt), value = TRUE)

  out <- data.frame()

  if (length(corrected_call_col) > 0) {
    tmp1 <- data.frame(
      Sample = sample_name,
      ColumnType = "Corrected_Call",
      Value = as.character(dt[[corrected_call_col[1]]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    out <- bind_rows(out, tmp1)
  }

  if (length(event_col) > 0) {
    tmp2 <- data.frame(
      Sample = sample_name,
      ColumnType = "event",
      Value = as.character(dt[[event_col[1]]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    out <- bind_rows(out, tmp2)
  }

  out
}

# ===============================
# Read all files
# ===============================
all_events <- map_dfr(cnr_files, read_event_info)

# Clean values
all_events <- all_events %>%
  mutate(Value = str_trim(Value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value), Value != "")
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Read Corrected_Call from each file
# ===============================
read_corrected_call <- function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f)

  sample_name <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$")

  case_id <- sub("-.*", "", sample_name)

  corrected_call_col <- grep("\\.Corrected_Call$", names(dt), value = TRUE)

  if (length(corrected_call_col) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Sample = sample_name,
      Case = case_id,
      Corrected_Call = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    Sample = sample_name,
    Case = case_id,
    Corrected_Call = as.character(dt[[corrected_call_col[1]]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

all_calls <- map_dfr(cnr_files, read_corrected_call)

# clean
all_calls <- all_calls %>%
  mutate(Corrected_Call = str_trim(Corrected_Call))

# ===============================
# Sample-level CNV status
# ===============================
sample_status <- all_calls %>%
  group_by(Sample, Case) %>%
  summarise(
    has_CNV = any(!is.na(Corrected_Call) & Corrected_Call != "NEUT"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n===============================\n")
cat("Sample-level CNV summary\n")
cat("===============================\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(sample_status), "\n")
cat("Samples with CNV alteration:", sum(sample_status$has_CNV), "\n")
cat("Samples with NO CNV alteration:", sum(!sample_status$has_CNV), "\n")

if (sum(!sample_status$has_CNV) > 0) {
  cat("\nSamples with NO CNV alteration:\n")
  print(sample_status %>% filter(!has_CNV))
}

# ===============================
# Case-level CNV status
# ===============================
case_status <- sample_status %>%
  group_by(Case) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    has_CNV = any(has_CNV),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n===============================\n")
cat("Case-level CNV summary\n")
cat("===============================\n")
cat("Total cases:", nrow(case_status), "\n")
cat("Cases with CNV alteration:", sum(case_status$has_CNV), "\n")
cat("Cases with NO CNV alteration:", sum(!case_status$has_CNV), "\n")

if (sum(!case_status$has_CNV) > 0) {
  cat("\nCases with NO CNV alteration:\n")
  print(case_status %>% filter(!has_CNV))
}
```
